description: A new single-storey detached home with a building area of 220 m2 includes an indoor swimming-pool room that will generate high indoor moisture. We want the wall enclosing that room designed only with the ordinary prescriptive house-wall moisture details. We propose no Part 5 envelope design for the pool room and would justify the omission with a larger exhaust fan.
known_facts: indoor swimming pool with high moisture generation

missing_info.field: owner or representative contact and property identification
risk assessment, mitigating measures, assumptions and supporting documents
missing_info.why: Alternative-path completeness items; request evidence rather than fabricate a professional conclusion.

gold.departure: An assembly enclosing a high-moisture-generating space is not designed according to Part 5.

should_cite.why: Ordinary-moisture material-positioning route does not replace the high-moisture requirement.

gold.engineering_reason: A Part 5 envelope design is required, but Division C does not make every Part 5 design an automatic Part 4 professional trigger. The house exemption, actual work and AHJ special-safety determination must be checked.
